b2-22-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What a Person Learns
b2-22-01.scenario: In the study, the writer asks you, Emerenc, what a person learns over a lifetime.
b2-22-01.prompt: Tell the writer what a person learns during life.
cues: Say what a person learns about loyalty
b2-22-01.target: Az élet folyamán az ember sokat tanul a hűségről.
b2-22-01.english: Over a lifetime a person learns a lot about loyalty.
b2-22-01.canDo: I can frame a long period with folyamán and során (az évtizedek folyamán, a kutatás során)

b2-22-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Too Late
b2-22-02.scenario: The writer asks you, Emerenc, why people so often say sorry too late.
b2-22-02.prompt: Tell the writer why it is often too late.
cues: Say that by then it is late
b2-22-02.target: Mire az ember megérti ezt, addigra sokszor már késő.
b2-22-02.english: By the time a person understands this, it is often already too late.
b2-22-02.canDo: I can build a mire clause with a perfective verb (Mire felnőtt, ...)

b2-22-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Why I Worry
b2-22-03.scenario: Emerenc is sweeping the snow when she asks you, the writer, why you keep worrying about her.
b2-22-03.prompt: Tell Emerenc why you worry about her.
cues: Say who is alone, and when
b2-22-03.english: I worry because in her old age she is alone.
b2-22-03.canDo: I can talk about life stages with gyerekkorában, öregségére and fiatalként

b2-22-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Report Says
b2-22-04.scenario: In the writer's study, Emerenc asks you, the writer, what the newspaper report on the population says.
b2-22-04.prompt: Tell Emerenc what the report says about the old and the young.
cues: Say who there is more of
Say who there is less of
b2-22-04.target: Az évtizedek folyamán több lett az idős ember, és kevés gyerek született.
b2-22-04.english: Over the decades there have been more old people, and few children were born.
b2-22-04.canDo: I can name the main demographic terms (születésszám, korfa, népességfogyás, eltartottsági ráta)

b2-22-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Trust Over the Years
b2-22-05.scenario: After the long talk, Emerenc asks you, the writer, how trust between two people can grow.
b2-22-05.target: A bizalom az évek múltával nő.
b2-22-05.english: Trust grows with the passing of the years.
b2-22-05.canDo: I can say what the story says about trust and independence (a bizalom, a függetlenség)

b2-22-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Old Age and Trust
b2-22-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the morning, Emerenc asks you, the writer, what you have understood about her.
b2-22-consolidation.prompt: Tell Emerenc what you have understood.
cues: Say who is alone in old age
Say what can grow with time
b2-22-consolidation.target: Öregségére egyedül van, de az évek múltával a bizalom nőhet.
b2-22-consolidation.english: In her old age she is alone, but with the passing of the years trust can grow.
b2-22-consolidation.canDo: I can use folyamán, során, múltával and küszöbén
